newsitem.title: UK: Imperial Chemical close to deal with DuPont-paper.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Chemical close to deal with DuPont-paper.

text.p: Imperial Chemical Industries Plc is close to a deal with U.S. counterpart DuPont Co. to sell a large part of its industrial chemical operations, the Sunday Times said.
The potential package, worth an estimated $2 billion, would involve the sale of Imperial Chemical's titanium dioxide company, Tioxide.
The sale of a small part of the Unilever chemicals business to Wilmington, Del.-based DuPont may also be included, the newspaper said.
No comment was available from Imperial Chemical.
